SOVEREIGN

When the king falls, the network crowns another. Crash a leader and watch real nodes elect a new one, live, in 3D.

See how it works
Chapter 1

The king falls

Every distributed system has a leader that coordinates the others. Then it crashes, and the heartbeats stop.

No one is in charge, and no human is coming to help. The nodes have to notice the silence and fix it themselves.

Chapter 2

The election

Each castle is a real process sending real messages. Two classic algorithms compete to pick the next leader.

BullyShout upward. Any node with a higher ID answers and takes over. Fast, but chatty: up to n² messages.
RingPass a token around the circle, collecting every live ID. Calm and orderly: about 2n messages.
ELECTIONOKCOORDINATOR
Chapter 3

A new sovereign rises

The highest living ID wins. The crown moves, the realm agrees, and every message is counted so you can compare both algorithms with real numbers.

A kingdom you can break
